thread:
jia: Pushed a candidate int4 build for MistralX-7B-RT and ran a quick kv-phase warmup comparison vs Gemma-7B (same quant backend). Seeing a consistent perplexity bump and some odd tokenization collisions on punctuation-heavy prompts. Summary below.
jia: Micro results (local synthetic sample):
- mistralx-7b-rt int4: ppl=12.4 (+1.8 vs fp16 baseline), median latency=28ms, throughput=380 tok/s
- gemma-7b int4: ppl=11.2, median latency=30ms, throughput=360 tok/s
- mismatch: ~0.7% token id collisions on dataset with lots of em-dashes/ellipses ("—..." sequences)
jia: Also observed kv-cache warmup variance: first 8 tokens larger log-prob drop, stabilizes after prefix cached. Suspect rotary scaling + tokenizer mapping interplay.
vikram: can you paste the tokenization diffs for the failing prompts? sounds like vocab shadowing or sentinel folding.
jia: pasted token diffs below and a tiny repro.
jia: ```
# repro (run on candidate env)
python -m evals.sanity --model mistralx:int4 --prompts tests/punct-heavy.txt --gold tokens
# tokenizer config snippet used:
{"lower_case": false, "nfkc": true, "emoji_handling": "split", "sentinel_tokens": ["<s>"], "vocab_overlay": null}
```
jia: Example diff: 
- gold: [5023, 19, 88, 9999, 5]
- mistralx-int4: [5023, 19, 88, 9987, 5]  <-- 9999 -> 9987 for an em-dash cluster
- gemma-int4: [5023, 19, 88, 9999, 5]
(so Gemma matches gold, MistralX int4 remapped)
triage-bot: regression-suite/kv-warmup failed on candidate build 1769812345 (see https://ci/reports/1769812345)
lucas: curious — is this happening only on int4 packer? we recently changed our int4 bitpacking order (head-major -> head-minor). Could be tokenid endianess interacting with rotary headwise indexing.
vikram: good call. also check rotary alpha: small per-head scaling params can amplify a tiny token id misalignment into a logit shift. Try running with rotary_scale=1.0 (disable autotune) to see if ppl drop persists.
jia: running that now locally, will roll a short run with rotary_scale=1.0 and old int4 packer.
anika: for the bench, can we add a tiny cross-tokenizer test: run MistralX with Gemma tokenizer mapping layer (and vice-versa) to confirm if it's tokenizer-only vs model-io mismatch? quick to script.
jia: yes — I have a script. command I used: 
```
./scripts/cross_tokenizer_check.sh --model mistralx:int4 --other-tokenizer gemma --prompts tests/punct-heavy.txt --out out/mx_g_tokenmap.json
```
jia: results so far: MistralX+gemma-tokenizer aligns logits with gemma baseline for the few repro prompts -> suggests tokenizer mapping is primary cause. But kv-warmup logit transient still slightly worse even with gemma-tokenizer (so secondary effect remains).
lucas: that points to a two-factor problem: tokenizer mapping producing some token id shifts + kv-cache head-alignment / int4 kernel ordering amplifying early-step error.
vikram: plan: 1) bisect quant packer change (head-major vs head-minor) 2) run rotary_scale toggle test 3) reproduce with merged tokenizer mapping (and run small canary on dedicated node to rule out jitter). I'll take bisect.
lucas: I'll provision a dedicated node with identical kernel/driver versions and run the warmup with pinned seeds. will run both packers and rotary_scale toggles.
anika: I'll prepare a 50-prompt repro set (punct-heavy + emoji clusters + sentinel mix) and wire up to the eval dashboard so we can track ppl/latency regressions.
jia: I'll upload artifacts and diffs to the triage thread once packer bisect finishes. link: (will post)
vikram: also include a small decode trace (raw logits) for first 12 tokens — that helped me spot per-head sign flips last time.
jia: noted — adding decode_trace flag now.
lucas: FYI, if this ends up being tokenizer overlay mismatch we might push a temporary shim that remaps offending token ids at input layer for the Hosted API (cheap fix) while we sort quant kernel ordering upstream.
vikram: agree. prioritize correctness for canary traffic, then optimize.
anika: scheduling weekly triage item and tagging oncall if CI continues failing.
triage-bot: tagged #eng-ml on regression-suite/kv-warmup failure for 1769812345.
jia: thanks all — running the bisect + rotary toggle now. will update in ~45m with first artifacts. :thumbsup:
